verses.text: Be merciful unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: All the day long he fighting oppresseth me.

verses.text: Mine enemies would swallow me up all the day long; For they are many that fight proudly against me.

segments.text: Mine enemies would swallow me up all the day long;

verses.text: What time I am afraid, I will put my trust in thee.

verses.text: In God (I will praise his word), In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?

verses.text: All the day long they wrest my words: All their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.text: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps, Even as they have waited for my soul.

verses.text: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.

verses.text: Thou numberest my wanderings: Put thou my tears into thy bottle; Are they not in thy book?

verses.text: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call: This I know, that God is for me.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Jonath elem rehokim. A Psalm of David. Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath.
